brief.description: Names the session's brief, so sil records this call against the want behind it. A brief that is not the buyer's answers `not_found`.

domain.description: Sends the path the domain read returned.

query.description: Sends the shopping words: the thing as a shop lists it and the numbers that pick the product, never a sentence.

n.description: Asks for this many variants — one size or one colour each, grouped under their products.

key.description: Names the key from the domain read; `price` is a key every domain has.

op.description: Sends the operator the domain read listed for this key.

value.description: Sends the desired value, typed by the key's type.

currency.description: Required on money: sil holds no exchange rate, so the bound is tested against offers in this currency only, and `eur` matches no offer sil stores.

specs.description: Sends the product specs this search asks, written by the agent from the brief's; a key the domain does not hold is recorded, never refused.

ship_to.description: Leave this out: sil then localizes the search to the buyer's default address. Send it only when the buyer named another address, as the exact `label` `sil_whoami` lists — never a word like "default", never a country. It excludes no seller anywhere else — where the seller is, is the seller spec `country`, on the offers.
